mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates for future corporate earnings and increasing equity valuations, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 200k per month signals strong labor market demand, boosting consumer spending and corporate revenue expectations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > 200.0 in the most recent month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS exceeds 200.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or the signal fails to outperform baseline in 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in residential construction starts and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based recovery in private demand, which increases corporate revenue visibility and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day SPX returns in more than 50% of instances, or the interaction term's Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production below 100.0 (index 2017=100) indicates a contraction in real output, which triggers risk-off behavior and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO < 100.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or the signal generates positive returns in more than 55% of triggered cases.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% and inflation (CPIAUCSL) remains above 3.0%, the market prices in a high-interest-rate regime that suppresses equity valuations via higher discount rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during high-FEDFUNDS/high-CPIAUCSL periods (t-test p > 0.05) or the interaction signal fails to achieve Rank IC > 0.04 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption (RSAFS) combined with rising housing starts (HOUST) signals strong private demand, which increases corporate earnings visibility and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising RSAFS and HOUST fails to produce positive 60-day SPX returns in more than 60% of instances, or the interaction term's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 5.0% and payroll growth exceeds 150k, labor market tightness increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to delay rate cuts, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: tight labor market with wage pressure
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both UNRATE < 5.0 and PAYEMS > 150.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or the signal generates positive returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 100.0 and a concurrent drop in GDP growth (GDPC1) indicate a weakening real economy, which increases recession risk and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative during periods of declining INDPRO and GDPC1 (t-test p > 0.05) or the interaction signal fails to achieve Rank IC < -0.04 over any 3-year window.
